content.short: Entropy Advisors is an onchain research and strategy firm, known for its work with the Arbitrum DAO.
content.description: Entropy Advisors turns on-chain data into strategy work for protocols and DAOs, most visibly through its long-running engagement with the Arbitrum ecosystem, where it operates as an embedded team rather than an outside consultancy. It maintains dashboards for Robinhood Chain, a natural extension given that chain is built on Arbitrum's stack. Its output sits closer to advisory work than to a self-serve analytics product, which is why it is engaged per mandate rather than per seat.
content.meta: Entropy Advisors is an onchain research and strategy firm working with Arbitrum and Robinhood Chain.
